1_parties_and_buyer_credit.value: Buyer is Jutland Board & Packaging A/S, which is unrated. Its credit is supported by a parent guarantee from Jutland Industri Holding A/S.
1_parties_and_buyer_credit.quote: Buyer Jutland Board & Packaging A/S, unrated; parent guarantee from Jutland Industri Holding A/S
1_parties_and_buyer_credit.note: The Seller is not named by legal name; only the project, Havrebakke Wind Farm, is given. No rating trigger or guarantee amount is stated. The table is drawn from a legal due diligence summary and financial model v7, not from the contract itself.

2_facility.value: Onshore wind farm of 8 turbines and 48.0 MW at Ringkøbing-Skjern, Denmark, in bidding zone DK1.
2_facility.clause: Section 4.2, key terms table, row 2; project line in the header
2_facility.note: Only one capacity figure is given and it is not labelled AC or DC. The technology (onshore wind) is stated in the header line, not in the table row. No site address is given beyond the municipality.

3_supply_period.value: The supply period is 10 years from COD (commercial operation date).
3_supply_period.note: The modelling note says the base case runs the contract price for ten years and uses merchant DK1 forward prices after that.

4_cod_and_delay.value: Target COD is 1 Oct 2027 and the longstop date is 31 Mar 2028. Delay liquidated damages are EUR 9,600 per day, capped at EUR 1.75m.
4_cod_and_delay.quote: Target COD 1 Oct 2027; longstop 31 Mar 2028; LDs EUR 9,600/day, cap EUR 1.75m
4_cod_and_delay.note: The consequence of reaching the longstop date (for example a termination right) is not stated.

5_price_and_indexation.value: The contract price is EUR 54.50/MWh. 30 % of the price is CPI-indexed, starting in 2029.
5_price_and_indexation.note: The row does not say whether the price is fixed in nominal or real terms, or the base year for the CPI index.

6_volume_and_performance.value: Volume is pay-as-produced, covering 100 % of output. Expected annual production (P50) is 158 GWh/yr and a minimum of 118.5 GWh/yr is stated.
6_volume_and_performance.quote: Pay-as-produced, 100 % of output; P50 158 GWh/yr; minimum 118.5 GWh/yr
6_volume_and_performance.note: The remedy if production falls below the minimum is not stated. The row does not say whether the minimum is a contractual guarantee or only a modelling assumption. No availability guarantee is mentioned.

7_product_and_certificates.value: The Buyer receives the electricity and all guarantees of origin (GoOs).
7_product_and_certificates.note: No GoO volume or cost is stated. Capacity or other attributes are not mentioned.

8_curtailment.value: The Buyer may curtail for up to 150 hours per year and is compensated at the contract price. Curtailment ordered by the TSO (the transmission system operator) is not compensated.
8_curtailment.quote: Buyer right 150 h/yr, compensated at contract price; TSO curtailment uncompensated
8_curtailment.note: The treatment of negative prices is not addressed. The row does not say whether compensation takes the form of deemed delivery. No MWh cap is given.

9_delivery_point_and_balancing.value: Settlement is physical, with delivery at the 60 kV Havrebakke substation. The Buyer is the balance responsible party (BRP) and bears imbalance costs.
9_delivery_point_and_balancing.quote: Physical, 60 kV Havrebakke substation; buyer is BRP and bears imbalance

10_credit_support.value: The Seller provides a bank guarantee of EUR 2,500,000, running to COD plus 12 months. The Buyer provides a letter of credit (LC) for 9 months of payments.
10_credit_support.quote: Seller bank guarantee EUR 2,500,000 to COD + 12 months; buyer LC 9 months of payments
10_credit_support.note: The Buyer's LC is sized as 9 months of payments, with no EUR amount given. Its duration is not stated.

11_default_and_termination.value: The termination amount is calculated as mark-to-market against the forward curve for the remaining term.
11_default_and_termination.quote: Mark-to-market vs forward curve for remaining term
11_default_and_termination.note: The main events of default are not listed. The row is a one-line summary: it does not say which forward curve is used, who pays whom, or whether a floor or cap applies. The source is a legal due diligence summary, not the contract.

12_change_in_law_and_force_majeure.value: If the cost of a change in law exceeds EUR 250k per year, the parties renegotiate. If that fails, either party may terminate, with no termination amount payable. A force majeure event lasting more than 180 days gives a termination right.
12_change_in_law_and_force_majeure.quote: Renegotiation above EUR 250k/yr, then mutual termination right without termination amount; FM > 180 days termination right
12_change_in_law_and_force_majeure.note: Who bears change-in-law costs below the EUR 250k/yr threshold is not stated. The row does not say which party's cost the threshold measures, or who holds the force majeure termination right.
